#### Purpose  
The purpose of this PySpark notebook is to build the **Curated table (`odw_curated_db.appeal_group_c_curated_mipins`)** from the **Harmonised FINAL dataset (`odw_harmonised_db.appeal_group_c`)** 

#### Description  
This notebook extracts the all records from the Harmonised layer and writes them into the Curated layer as a managed Parquet table.  
No transformations or business logic are applied — it performs a **direct 1:1 projection** of the Harmonised active slice into Curated  

The process includes:  
- Selecting only relevant columns matching the Curated schema  
- Writing the final dataset in Parquet format to `odw_curated_db.appeal_group_c_curated_mipins`  
- Logging operational metrics (row counts, duration, errors) to **Azure Application Insights** at notebook exit for full audit traceability
